data.one_liner: A clean and robust undo/redo library for Dart and Flutter using the Command Pattern.
data.what_it_does: Provides a stack-based history mechanism to manage state changes. It lets you easily roll back or replay actions using individual or batched changes, as well as a SimpleStack for tracking a single state object.
use_when: You need to add undo and redo functionality to a Flutter or Dart application.
You want a lightweight history stack that works with any state management architecture like ChangeNotifier, Bloc, or Riverpod.
avoid_when: You need an all-in-one state management framework rather than a dedicated undo/redo helper.
strengths: Flexible architecture that integrates with any state management solution
weaknesses: Requires manual tracking of old state values and change logic
